home.why-faq.heading: Made rarely. Made well. Made for Bangladesh.
home.why-faq.description: Since 2017 we've designed and finished every piece in our Dhaka atelier — Italian wool, pure silk and premium cotton, in small batches. Over 40,000 customers across all 64 districts trust us.

faqs.q: How long does delivery take in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Inside Dhaka we deliver in 24–48 hours. Nationwide delivery takes 3–5 working days. Orders over ৳5,000 ship free.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: bKash, Nagad, Visa, Mastercard and Cash on Delivery. COD is available everywhere in Bangladesh with no extra charge.
24hours Exchange. Items must be unworn with tags attached. Request a return from your account or call us under 24 hours.

faqs.q: How do I find my size?
faqs.a: Every product page has a detailed size guide with measurements in cm. Our fits run true — size down for a closer fit.

faqs.q: Are your pieces really made in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Yes — designed and finished in our Dhaka atelier, using Imported Fabrics and Materials.

faqs.q: Is it safe to pay online?
faqs.a: Completely. Payments run through bKash and Nagad official gateways with SSL encryption. Or choose Cash on Delivery.
